name: RingCentral
description: RingCentral is a cloud communications platform providing business phone, team messaging, video meetings, and AI-powered customer engagement and contact center tools.
best_for: Businesses of all sizes, from small teams to Fortune 1000 enterprises, that need unified phone, video, messaging, and contact center capabilities in one platform.
features: Cloud-based business phone system (RingEX) with business SMS
AI Receptionist for automated call answering and routing
AIR Pro no-code custom AI agent builder
AI Virtual Assistant (AVA) for meeting notes and task automation
RingCX omnichannel contact center with AI-powered quality management
500+ third-party app integrations via open APIs
